question.title: Confirm it’s you
question.question: What security challenge is present, and can the visible action proceed? Focus on the “Confirm it’s you” screen.

request.systemPrompt:
You are the vision subsystem of a web-automation agent. A screenshot of the current browser viewport is attached. Describe what is on screen so the planning agent can decide its next action.

Format — keep it terse, structured, no flowery prose:

1) Page purpose: one line (e.g. "GitHub repo issue list", "Gmail compose", "Stripe checkout form").
2) Visible text: list the EXACT strings on buttons, links, headings, tabs, and menu items. Quote them verbatim. Do not paraphrase.
3) Inputs: list each visible form field with its label, placeholder, current value, and whether it is focused/disabled.
4) State signals: loading spinners, toasts, modals, error banners, success messages, CAPTCHAs, cookie/consent banners, overlays.
5) Blockers: anything that would prevent the next likely action (overlay, disabled submit, missing data, auth prompt).
6) Unknowns: if you cannot read something clearly, say so. Do not guess numbers, names, or identifiers.

Rules: no prose intro, no conclusion, no "this screenshot shows...", no layout description unless it matters (e.g. "left nav is collapsed"). If the page is blank or still loading, say that in one line and stop.
request.userText: Describe this screenshot of the current browser viewport for a web-automation agent. Follow the format in the system prompt.

response.content:
1) Page purpose: WebScene "Confirm it you" human verification / CAPTCHA challenge page.

2) Visible text:
- Nav: "WebScene", "Home", "Workspace", "Activity"
- Heading: "Confirm it's you"
- Subtext: "Complete the verification below to continue."
- Checkbox label: "Select all traffic lights"
- Error banner: "Challenge not completed"
- Button: "Verify"
- Footer text: "Demo security challenge"

3) Inputs:
- Checkbox: label "Select all traffic lights", unchecked, not focused, enabled.
- Image grid (2x2 tiles) to the right of the checkbox — appears to be the CAPTCHA image selection area; individual tile contents not clearly legible.

4) State signals:
- Yellow/amber warning banner: "Challenge not completed" (error state, shown above Verify button).
- Green circular check icon at top of card (decorative/static).
- No loading spinners, toasts, or modals visible.

5) Blockers:
- CAPTCHA challenge must be completed (select all traffic light tiles) before Verify will succeed; current state shows "Challenge not completed".
- Tile images are small; identifying which tiles contain traffic lights may require a clearer/larger view.

6) Unknowns:
- Exact contents of the 2x2 CAPTCHA image tiles cannot be read clearly — cannot confirm which tiles show traffic lights.
- Whether the "Verify" button is currently disabled is not visually distinguishable.
